nodeData.topic: Bhagavad-gita in your language — chapter summaries · draft
nodeData.note: Draft · translations unreviewed. The Bhagavad-gita chapter by chapter in ten languages — Hindi, Swahili, Gujarati, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Spanish and French. Every bubble is our own one-line summary of one verse in that language (not the BBT translation), linked to that verse on vedabase.io — in Spanish and French to their own vedabase edition, otherwise to the English page. Native reviewers are wanted for every language: if you can check one, please tell the Manas team. Chapters 1–2 so far, one chapter a week. Search words: Gita, Gītā, गीता, Bhagavad Gita, Arjuna, Krishna, Kurukshetra, languages, translation, tafsiri.
